items.description: A prominent Catholic cathedral in Yaounde. It is one of the capital's best known civic and religious landmarks.
The Basilica of Mary Queen of Apostles in Mvolye is a major church in Yaounde. It is a landmark of modern Catholic architecture.
A large modern stadium in the north of Yaounde. It hosts major football matches and national events.
A national monument in Yaounde that marks Cameroon's reunification. It is one of the city's most recognizable symbols.
Cameroon's national museum in Yaounde. It displays objects that trace the country's cultural and political history.
A major cathedral in Douala and an important religious landmark of the coastal city. It anchors the city's Catholic community.
A large stadium in Douala used for football and public events. It is one of Cameroon's main sports venues.
A well known statue in Douala representing freedom and modern city life. It has become one of the city's most photographed landmarks.
The bridge over the Wouri River linking parts of Douala. It is a vital transport connection for the country's main port city.
The royal palace in Foumban is a standout landmark of the Bamoun kingdom. Its architecture and museum make it a key visitor site.
A stadium in Maroua used for football and local gatherings. It is one of the main sports grounds in the Far North.
The lighthouse of Kribi is a familiar coastal landmark. It stands near the Atlantic shore and recalls the town's maritime role.
Cameroon's national stadium in Yaounde. It hosts major football matches and state events.
